deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a bibliographic memorandum headed 'Neue Bücher von 1822' (New books of 1822). It continues the list-keeping of the neighbouring pages: the previous page lists 1821/22 titles plus dated notes on the Hanover survey reports; the next page lists 'Neue Bücher von 1823' and '1824'. The entries, with probable identifications, are:
(1) Prince Maximilian zu Wied-Neuwied, Reise nach Brasilien in den Jahren 1815 bis 1817, vols. 1–2, quarto.
(2) J. A. Grunert, Mathematische Abhandlungen, vol. 1, quarto.
(3) Burg, Die geometrische Zeichenkunst, 1822, parts 1–2, octavo.
(4) Finke, on the 'Moorrauch' (moor smoke / haze) in Westphalia, etc., octavo.
(5) Tilloch's Philosophical Magazine and Journal, year 1822.
(6) (Quarterly) Journal of Science, Literature and the Arts (Royal Institution), nos. 24, 25, 26.
(7) 'Graham', Travels through Portugal and Spain during the Peninsular War, 1820, octavo.
(8) Nathan Drake, Winter Nights, or Fireside Lucubrations, vols. 1–2, 1820.
(9) Bulletin des sciences par la Société philomathique de Paris, 1821.
(10) Histoire et Mémoires de l'Institut royal de France, tomes 5–6.
(11) Annales de chimie et de physique, 1821–1822.
(12) Biot & Arago, Recueil d'observations géodésiques, astronomiques et physiques, 1821, quarto.
(13) Hachette, Géométrie descriptive, 1820.
(14) de Prony, Nouvelle méthode de nivellement trigonométrique, 1822. A marginal '4' precedes this entry.
(15) A.-L. Cauchy, Cours d'analyse de l'École royale polytechnique, part 1 (Analyse algébrique, 1821).
(16) A.-J. Saint-Martin, Notice sur le zodiaque de Denderah, 1822.
(17) G. Santini, Tavole dei logaritmi, 1820, octavo. A marginal '1' precedes this entry.
(18) Memoirs of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences, vol. 4, part 2, 1821.
These are presumably recent acquisitions, most likely of the Göttingen library, that Gauss noted as having seen or wanting to read; the purpose is uncertain. Several entries connect to his current work. The geodetic titles (Biot–Arago, de Prony on trigonometric levelling) match his Hanover arc measurement; the previous page has 'Bericht über die Höhen', i.e. a report on the heights. Cauchy's Cours d'analyse, Grunert and Hachette reflect his mathematical reading. The marginal digits 4 and 1 may be priority or ordering marks; their meaning is unclear. There are no derivations to reconstruct.

results.what: Gauss's reading/acquisition list for 1822, including Cauchy's Cours d'analyse (1821) and de Prony's trigonometric levelling (1822)

deep.surprise_reason: Purely a list of book titles. It is mildly useful as documentation that Gauss registered Cauchy's Cours d'analyse and recent French geodetic works in 1822, but it contains no mathematics.
transcription_corrections: 'Maximilian Pr. von Neuwied': the hand reads like 'Fr.' or 'Pr.'; the intended person is Prince Maximilian zu Wied-Neuwied.
'Biot et Arago recueil...': the image confirms the '4.' at the end is the quarto format, not a volume number.
Marginal '4' before de Prony and '1' before Santini are separate marginal marks, not part of the titles.
'Hist. & Memoires de l'institut roial de France' keeps the period spelling 'roial', which is correct as written.
